method: Independent feasibility pass over raw shards. Mechanical validation (id contiguity, field census, kill-threshold digit scan, citation-string scan), GATE-4 named-asset detection over both experiment fields against a public dataset/model lexicon built from the shards own proper-noun census then verified by spot-reads (false-negative sources found and fixed: xView3, WSDDN, timm, iNaturalist, MIT-States, UT-Zappos, MIDOG, CTransPath, Phikon, PACO, DocBank; false positives removed: TIDE, IRT, case-insensitive WIT-matches-with), per-idea tier/score from the generators own stated time/device bounds, deep read of top TF-IDF-cosine pairs for merge decisions, cosine collision pass against the 638-record read-only master.
epistemic_status: Feasibility and cost judgments only; no novelty ranking (Judge A lane) and no numbers invented anywhere. Scores reflect the generators own stated bounds, sanity-checked against the described protocols.

scoring_rules.tier_T1_inference_or_analysis_only: stated fastest bound <= 1 GPU-day equivalent AND no from-scratch encoder pretraining (probes, light heads, zoo re-scoring, analysis)
scoring_rules.tier_T2_small_training_gpu_days: training runs required or bound > 1 GPU-day; all w5 T2 bounds are <= 14 GPU-days on one standard GPU
scoring_rules.tier_T3_gated: no public pilot path (none in w5)
scoring_rules.score_5: killable <= 1 GPU-day on public assets by the generators own bound
scoring_rules.score_3: > 5 to <= 14 GPU-days public, or one-point discount for gated-confirmation/human-annotation caveats
scoring_rules.score_2: generator admits the public pilot is underpowered (N-020 only)
